pulses.name: FlowerStorm Phishing Kit Targeting Microsoft Credentials via Cloudflare-Backed Infrastructure
pulses.description: IOCs related to FlowerStorm phishing‑kit–driven campaign that delivers fake Microsoft authentication pages via compromised domains fronted by Cloudflare. The activity abuses legitimate cloud and CDN services for delivery while credential harvesting occurs on attacker‑controlled infrastructure, with incidental contact to Microsoft services during normal browser behavior. that uses its own web serve
